macros.name: destinatario
macros.doc: \destinatario{⟨recipient⟩} defines the recipient of the letter, if no recipient is provided the letter will be addressed to ”To whom it may concern” (or ”A chi di competenza” if the languaga is italian).

macros.name: dipartimentoDi
macros.doc: The name of the department can be specified using the \dipartimentoDi{⟨department name⟩} macro.

macros.name: esoggetto
macros.doc: \esoggetto{⟨label⟩} changes the word that precedes the subject topic, replaces the default ”Subject:”.

macros.name: firma
macros.doc: \firma{⟨image file⟩} defines an image file (typically a PNG) that contains a scanned signature of the person.

macros.name: homepage
macros.doc: \homepage{⟨url⟩} defines the (optional) URL of the personal home page.

macros.name: logo
macros.doc: \logo{⟨image file⟩} defines the image file containing the logo used in the header of the letter.

macros.name: ruolo
macros.doc: \ruolo{⟨role⟩} defines the role of the person, e.g. Full Professor.

macros.name: soggetto
macros.doc: \soggetto{⟨subject⟩} defines the subject of the letter, that will appear, at the top of the letter preceded by the word ”Subject:” (or ”Soggetto:” if the language is italian).

macros.name: struttura
macros.doc: By default the organizational unit is a department, but it is possible to set the type of the organizational unit using \struttura{⟨structure type⟩} macro.

macros.name: telefono
macros.doc: \telefono{⟨phone number⟩} defines the office phone number.
